title: Auto unlink PAYG environments
subtitle: When budget threshold is breached, the chain finds the policy and unlinks its environments.

steps.title: Budget alert is triggered
steps.evidence: An Azure Budget alert calls an Automation runbook, which uses managed identity to invoke Power Automate; the flow finds the policy and unlinks its environments.

steps.title: Runbook invokes Power Automate
steps.evidence: An Azure Budget alert calls an Automation runbook, which uses managed identity to invoke Power Automate; the flow finds the policy and unlinks its environments.

steps.title: Flow unlinks environments
steps.evidence: the flow finds the policy and unlinks its environments.
